auth_type.correction: Token-based authentication; documented services use API tokens or Bearer JWTs

free_tier.correction: true (time-limited free trial, not a permanent free plan)

free_tier_limits.correction: Official FAQ advertises a 7-day license and 250 API calls; allowances may vary by service

rate_limits.correction: QUODD states there is no production call-count limit and recommends about 200 symbols maximum per call

example.correction: Use a documented product endpoint with authentication, such as POST https://api.quodd.com/universal/jobs with Authorization: Bearer TOKEN, Accept: application/json, Content-Type: application/json, and the documented job body

description.correction: QUODD provides publicly accessible REST and gRPC developer documentation. API access is credentialed through trial or firm accounts, and a free trial is publicly advertised.

notes: QUODD remains operational, but this entry understates its public documentation and misses its advertised free trial. Official sources conflict on trial duration: the FAQ says 7 days/250 calls, while developer terms mention 30 days. The unauthenticated root curl is not a documented API example.
